summary: Ship ACM-scale coverage and authorized reputation ingestion
description: Release the complete data-expansion slice only after the source index, ACM bulk production read model, calibrated status contract, authorized ingestion boundary, agent surfaces, privacy review, and live production evidence pass.
acceptance: The full ACM catalog is built from the current checksum-pinned official CC0 source and proven live in production with honest freshness and coverage statistics.

The caller-report service index is current and every actually ingested reputation source has explicit compatible rights, privacy, provenance, correction, and takedown evidence; no permission-required site is scraped.

All canonical surfaces preserve calibrated four-state semantics, repository history contains no real report corpus or generated database, strict public repo-complete has zero blockers, and production browser and protocol probes pass.
